name: mun-toolkit
description: Offline multi-hop chat and file network for Model United Nations conferences

scripts.e2e: npm run export:web -w app && node --no-warnings --import ./scripts/register-ts.mjs scripts/e2e.ts
scripts.build:android:dev: npm exec --yes -w app --package=eas-cli -- eas build -p android --profile development
scripts.build:android:preview: npm exec --yes -w app --package=eas-cli -- eas build -p android --profile preview
